blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-migration-1 (rename_all = "camelCase" renames every existing order JSON field) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-migration-2 (New required default_currency key makes existing config.toml fail to load) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` so `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents` keep their names and only `currency` is added. Today `GET /orders/{id}` serializes them as `orderId`, `customerId` and `totalCents`, so every partner integration reading `order_id`/`customer_id`/`total_cents` gets missing fields right after the release, without any BREAKING item, contrary to docs/api.md ("a field is never renamed or removed without two releases of deprecation") and to the docs, which still list the snake_case names. If camelCase is wanted, emit both names during the deprecation period and announce it as BREAKING in the release note.
findings.title: rename_all = "camelCase" renames every existing order JSON field

findings.recommendation: Give the field a default (`#[serde(default = "default_currency")]` returning "EUR", the currency orders had before) and test that a config without the key still loads. Today every deployed `config.toml`, which holds only `database_url` and `listen`, makes `toml::from_str` return a "missing field `default_currency`" error at start-up, so the upgraded service does not start; the release note names no manual step. Otherwise mark it BREAKING in the release note with the key operators must add.
findings.title: New required default_currency key makes existing config.toml fail to load
